basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old from Louisville, Kentucky, navigating the world of Reddit as I seek advice and share experiences during unemployment. I have a background in retail management but am currently exploring opportunities in tech. I enjoy binge-watching 'A Million Little Things' and diving into historical naval fiction in my free time. Recently, I've developed an interest in cryptocurrency and am trying to learn more about it. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late nights, balancing my time between job hunting and personal projects. Currently single, focusing on personal growth and career development.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a high school diploma and some college experience in business administration. I've mostly learned my skills on the job in retail management, but I'm now teaching myself coding through online courses. My knowledge of politics and economics is mostly self-taught, supplemented by discussions and articles I find online.
